title: Te Tukunga Nui a te Ariki
intro: Ka kitea koe i tētahi whenua o ngā mea whakamiharo onamata me ngā whakakitenga hohonu. I tūtaki tētahi rangatira mana nui ki tētahi pōwhiri ohorere, ā, ka tīmata ia i tētahi haerenga ka huri i te huarahi o tōna aituā me te whakapono o tōna iwi. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri o tēnei tangata rangatira?
clues: I kingi ahau i runga i tētahi kingitanga whai rawa, he taonga nui, he torona whakahīhī hoki.
I karakia mātou ko tōku iwi ki tētahi tinana o te rangi, i te whakapono ko ia tō mātou ariki, ahakoa i ruarua ahau i roto i tōku ngākau.
I homai e tētahi karere rerekē, he manu, tētahi reta ki ahau, e karanga ana i ahau me tōku iwi kia ngohengohe ki te Atua Kotahi.
I kōrero ahau ki aku kaitohutohu, he hunga kaha rawa, mō te āhua o te whakautu ki tēnei karere kāore i kitea i mua.
I whakatau ahau ki te tuku atu i tētahi koha tino nui ki te tangata nāna i tuku mai te reta, me te tumanako ka taea e au te aromatawai i tōna mana me āna whakaaro.
I taku taenga atu, i miharo ahau ki tētahi whare rangatira, he papa karāhe tōna, he rite ki tētahi puna wai, ā, i taua wā ka whakapuaki ahau i taku ngohengohe ki te Ariki o ngā mea hanga katoa.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
